title: STG Drops Hoyo Epicure Seleccion and Ten More Items From Its Price List
summary: STG's new price lists bring almost no price increases — a few items moved by pennies — but remove 11 products from the General Cigar Co. list, led by the Hoyo de Monterrey Epicure Seleccion line.

title: Crowned Heads Brings Back Las Calaveras Decimo in Three Sizes for 2026
summary: The 2024 tenth-anniversary blend returns as the Decimo 2026 in three sizes made by My Father Cigars — a limited run of 75,000 cigars that began shipping on October 30.

title: Fratello Cigars Adds Distribution in Sweden Through Kind Cigars
summary: Fratello has signed Kind Cigars — founded in 2011 by Martin Nelson — to distribute its cigars in Sweden, a deal that began with a meeting at InterTabac and extends a network of some thirty markets.

title: Oliva Serie V Melanio Edicion Ano 2026 Arrives With an Unusual Perfecto Shape
summary: The 2026 edition of Oliva's annual limited vitola — a 5 3/8 x 54 shape that is half parejo, half perfecto, built around the warm, rainy 2023-24 Jalapa harvest — reached U.S. stores on November 2, limited to 9,000 boxes at $20.

title: Powstanie War Bear 2026 Box-Pressed Churchill Set for November 11 Release
summary: A barber-pole 7 x 48 box-pressed Churchill from Nica Sueño, limited to 390 boxes of 21 at $16.50, named for Wojtek, the bear enlisted in the Polish army in the Second World War.

title: Saint Luis Rey Eiroa 30th Anniversary Goes Maduro, Shipping to TAA Retailers First
summary: Altadis U.S.A. and Christian Eiroa add a darker Maduro expression to their 30th Anniversary line, in four sizes at $12 to $13.50, made at the C.L.E. factory in Danli and sold only through brick-and-mortar shops.

title: Super El Niño Destroys More Than Half of A.S.P.'s 2026 Ecuador Crop
summary: A.S.P. Enterprises has told clients to expect only 25–35 percent of their orders after excessive rain destroyed more than half of its 2026 crop — a blow to the wrapper supply behind a third of the new cigars launched at PCA 2026.

title: InterTabac Looks to 2027: More Than 90% of Exhibitors Plan to Return
summary: InterTabac, NUBIZ and InterSupply have begun preparing their 2027 edition — September 14–16 at Messe Dortmund — with more than 90 percent of exhibitors planning to exhibit again.

title: J.C. Newman to Unveil New Cuesta-Rey Band at Big Smoke Las Vegas
summary: J.C. Newman will debut a redesigned band for Cuesta-Rey — the brand founded in 1884 and once the official cigar of Spain's King Alfonso XIII — on November 7 at Cigar Aficionado's Big Smoke in Las Vegas.

title: Plasencia Announces 2026 Holiday Collection: Five Toros From Five Lines
summary: The five-count set draws one toro each from Reserva Original, Alma del Fuego, Alma del Cielo, Alma Fuerte and Alma de Campo, in a snowflake-embossed green box at $99.99, shipping in November.

title: Tatuaje Boris Karloff Returns for 2026 in Its Thinnest Size Yet
summary: The third Boris Karloff release is a 6 1/4 x 47 toro — the thinnest Boris to date — with an Ecuadorian Sumatra-seed wrapper, rolled at My Father Cigars and limited to 2,000 boxes of 20.

title: Dunbarton's Shokai Bushido Debuts at Cigartopia on November 14, Born of the Takumi Project
summary: Steve Saka will unveil Shokai Bushido, a one-off Cigar Dojo collaboration for Cigars Daily, at Cigartopia in Phoenix on November 14 — a cigar that spun out of Takumi, the very limited blend he has worked on for three years.

title: Forged Brings Back La Gloria Cubana Gran Legado for a Limited 2026 Run
summary: The 7 3/4 x 62 perfecto, first released in 2024 and carrying the signature of the veteran El Credito roller who made it, returns for 2026 in ten-count boxes at $15.89.

title: Plasencia Unveils El Año de la Cabra, Its Seventh Zodiac Cigar
summary: The seventh Plasencia zodiac release is a single 6 1/4 x 60 perfecto rolled in Honduras from mostly Honduran leaf, limited to 6,000 boxes of ten at $600, shipping at the end of November.

title: U.S. Premium Cigar Imports Flat Through August; Honduras Up 11.4%
summary: U.S. imports of handmade cigars rose just 0.6 percent to 282.2 million through August, with Nicaragua flat at 168.7 million, the Dominican Republic down 6.3 percent, and Honduras surging 11.4 percent to 53.3 million.
maker: Industry statistics (Cigar Association of America data)

title: Arturo Fuente's Rare Pink: A 1960s Homage in Perfectos That Funds Breast Cancer Research
summary: Introduced in 2020, the Rare Pink Vintage 1960 Series unites six perfecto sizes as Carlito Fuente's tribute to the decade of his youth — and sends $13 from every box to the Breast Cancer Research Foundation.

title: Smoke Inn Releases Black Works Studio Killer Bee Buzz Saw 2.0
summary: The second Smoke Inn exclusive from Oveja Negra Brands recasts the Buzz Saw blend as a 5 1/4 x 54 box-pressed belicoso, sold in ten-count boxes at $120 and five-packs at $60.

title: Davidoff Year of the Sheep 2027: All Three Formats Are Figurados
summary: For the first time in the zodiac series' history, all three formats are figurados in tribute to a sheep's horn — a 17,500-box piramides, an 850-box flagship gran perfecto, and a 12-piece Masterpiece Humidor.

title: Domain Cigars Opens a Test Blend Portal for Its Flagship Retailers
summary: Domain's flagship retailers and their customers can now log flavour notes, construction and burn feedback — plus a personal score out of 100 — on unreleased blends from Esteban Disla and Kevin Baxter, with the notes going straight to the blenders.

title: Selected Tobacco Opens Five-Storey Madrid Headquarters, Reviving Cigar Making in the Capital
summary: Nelson Alfonso's Selected Tobacco celebrated the grand opening of its five-storey Madrid facility on October 10-11 — the first premium cigar production site in the city in more than half a century, with a gala for some 250 to 300 guests.

title: Brolo Cigar Co. Debuts November 19 With Three Blends From a Husband-and-Wife Startup
summary: Texas startup Brolo Cigar Co., founded by Joshua and Kaitlyn Stephens, launches with three regular-production robustos — Porchlight, Confessional and Back Booth — at $14.75 to $16.25, debuting in McKinney on November 19.

title: Gellis Family Cigars Adds Piece Unique Emerald Sky, Limited to 3,000 Cigars
summary: The second Piece Unique of 2026 is a 5 1/2 x 48 one-off blend with rare Peruvian pelo d'oro in the filler, priced at $40 and scheduled to ship in late November.

title: Marvin R. Shanken, Founder of Cigar Aficionado, Dies at 83
summary: The M. Shanken Communications founder, who launched Cigar Aficionado in 1992 and helped turn cigars into luxury products, died on October 29; U.S. premium imports roughly quadrupled within five years of his magazine’s debut.

title: Arturo Fuente, Casa Carrillo, Padrón and Rocky Patel Join World Cigar Show Dubai Lineup
summary: Four major brands exhibit for the first time at the PCA-partnered World Cigar Show at the Dubai World Trade Centre on November 10–11, showcased by Baqer Mohebi Enterprises.

title: Quai d'Orsay Concordia Edicion Limitada 2026 Premieres in Madrid
summary: Only the second Limited Edition in the brand's history, the new Preciosos vitola (145 mm x 50) premiered at La Nuit D'Orsay in the Las Ventas bullring before more than 400 guests; boxes of 20 are priced at EUR 914.

title: Habanos Names a Commercial Vice President, a Marketing Director and a Quality Director
summary: Three official appointments in five weeks, Alberto Donar Cruz Rojas as Commercial Vice President on September 23, Dariel Regal Veitia, who began as a torcedor, as Operational Marketing Director on September 30, and Ruben Tomas Pradas as Quality Director on October 21.

title: Villiger's San Martín: A New Handmade Premium Brand Named for South America's Liberator
summary: Villiger's 2026 premium launch is handmade at Tabacalera ABAM in the Dominican Republic, with a deliberately undisclosed all-Caribbean blend, in robusto, piramides and churchill formats in boxes of 20.

title: Villiger TAA Exclusive Returns for 2026, Made at the Company's Own Nicaraguan Factory
summary: After a year off, Villiger's TAA Exclusive is a 6 x 52 box-pressed toro from Villiger de Nicaragua, limited to 500 boxes of ten at $13 per cigar and released on November 2.

title: Bolivar Safari, the First Regional Edition for the Whole of Africa, Debuts November 21
summary: A first for the Edicion Regional programme, the Bolivar Safari is a 54 x 111 mm Torres with a pigtail, debuting on November 21 in Abidjan in 16,666 numbered boxes of 12 at roughly 43 euros.

title: Cuba's 2026-27 Tobacco Season Opens under an Energy Crisis
summary: Tabacuba targets 20,000 hectares and 22,000 tons, with half the plantings to be irrigated by renewable power, but its agricultural director warns the season 'will be difficult again'.

title: Cohiba Talisman Joins the Linea Clasica as a Regular Release
summary: First sold as a 2017 Limited Edition, the 54 x 154 mm Talisman becomes the ninth regular vitola of the Linea Clasica; its London launch on Oct. 7 opened the Cohiba 60th anniversary year.

title: After Thirty Years, BAT Quietly Sells Its Brascuba Stake and Leaves Cuba
summary: BAT sold its 50 percent of the Brascuba cigarette joint venture to the Tabacuba-linked Tabagest, in an agreement dated December 19, 2025, ending a presence that began in 1995, with no public statement from either side.

title: Montecristo Fragata Debuts as a Duty-Free and Travel Retail Exclusive
summary: Unveiled at TFWA in Cannes on Sept. 29, the new Duke-format vitola (54 x 140 mm) comes only in a 20-cigar travel humidor priced at $1,280, exclusively for duty-free and travel retail channels.

title: Trinidad Vigia Reserva Cosecha 2022 Is the Brand's First Reserva
summary: Trinidad's first Reserva uses leaves aged at least three extra years in the 54 x 110 mm Vigia vitola — 5,000 numbered boxes of 20 at $3,800, 5,000 gift boxes of three at $660, and an NFC chip in the band.

title: La Gloria Cubana 35 Aniversario Humidor Goes on Sale in Switzerland October 6
summary: Marking 35 years of La Casa del Habano rather than of the brand, the 35-cigar Rodolfo humidor (750 made, CHF 3,850) reaches Switzerland's ten LCDH stores on October 6, alongside the Romeo y Julieta Amantes 20-count box.

title: Cuba's Cigar Paradox: Record Revenue on a Shrinking Leaf Supply
summary: In a long Cigar Journal analysis, Philip G. Wynne argues that Habanos has made scarcity profitable, with $827 million in 2024 revenue, while the fields, the ownership structure and New World competition close in.

title: The FT Investigates Habanos' Ultra-Luxury Turn and the Cost to the Brand
summary: A Financial Times investigation traces how the post-2020 ownership era doubled Cuban cigar prices and lifted revenue to $827 million by 2024, while retailers say the strategy is driving habitual smokers toward New World cigars.

title: Big Smoke Las Vegas Marks 30 Years With Guy Fieri and the Top Cigars of 2025
summary: Cigar Aficionado's Big Smoke Las Vegas celebrates its 30th anniversary on November 6-7 at Horseshoe Las Vegas, headlined by a Guy Fieri interview and seminars built around the magazine's top cigars of 2025.

title: Por Larrañaga 35 Aniversario Marks 5th Avenue's Anniversary in Germany
summary: The German regional edition (194 mm x 49) went on sale August 31 at EUR 35 per cigar and EUR 1,750 per box of 50, limited to 100,000 cigars, for distributor 5th Avenue's 35th anniversary.

title: Cohiba Atmosphere TLV Opens at The David Kempinski Tel Aviv
summary: Cohiba Atmosphere TLV, inside The David Kempinski Tel Aviv, is Israel's first destination created to embody premium Cuban cigar culture, and the country's exclusive home for Cuban cigars.

title: 26th Festival del Habano Will Not Be Held in 2026
summary: The organizing committee confirmed on July 20 that the postponed 26th festival will not take place this year, while the Cohiba 60th anniversary programme continues worldwide, opening with the Talisman launch in London.

title: Six Years On, the Montecristo Herederos Finally Reaches Swiss Shops
summary: Announced at the 2020 Festival del Habano and long feared a pandemic casualty, the Churchill-format Herederos (162 mm x 47) went on sale in Switzerland in July 2026 at CHF 59, reserved for LCDH and Habanos Specialist outlets.

title: Spain Seizes 33,840 Counterfeit Cuban Cigars Near Valencia
summary: The Guardia Civil seized 33,840 fake Cuban cigars at a residence in Mislata, Valencia, where they were being fitted with counterfeit bands and packaged for distribution throughout Europe, Cigar Journal reports.

title: Bolívar Evento 55, France's 2025 Regional Edition, Reaches Tobacconists at €35
summary: The Bolívar Evento 55 Edición Regional France 2025 — a 140 mm x 52 genios, a first for the brand — is on sale in France in 4,000 cabinets of 50 at €35 a cigar.

title: Switzerland's Eleventh La Casa del Habano Opens in Kreuzlingen, by Lake Constance
summary: The Portmann family opened Switzerland's eleventh La Casa del Habano in Kreuzlingen on June 26, adding a store with a smoking lounge near the German border to their St. Gallen presence.

title: Cuba Opens Farmland to Private Companies — but the Tobacco Monopolies Stay
summary: Three of the 176 economic measures Cuba adopted on June 19 touch tobacco directly — private legal entities can now hold farmland in usufruct for an indefinite period, and fuel and renewable-energy equipment can be imported directly.

title: La Gloria Cubana Série Brasil No. 3: Brazil's Third Regional Edition
summary: The campana-format (52 x 140 mm) Série Brasil No. 3 arrives in 6,000 numbered boxes of 10 at an average of EUR 490, and brings the La Gloria Cubana brand itself to Brazil.

title: La Casa del Habano Kuala Lumpur Celebrates Its First Anniversary
summary: The 'new' La Casa del Habano Kuala Lumpur marked its first anniversary in May with an extended guest list, one year after the store opened.

title: Por Larrañaga Intemporales, the Swiss Regional Edition 2023, Set for June Release
summary: Habanos has announced a June 2026 release for the Por Larrañaga Intemporales, the Swiss Regional Edition 2023 — a three-year lag that underlines the regional program's supply delays.

title: S.T. Dupont Opens the Cohiba 60th Anniversary Collection, Lighters from €690
summary: The first part of S.T. Dupont's Cohiba 60th anniversary collection launched on June 8 — three lighters (€690 to €2,300), each limited to 1,966 pieces, with a second instalment due in November.

title: Tabacuba Aims Again for 14,000 Hectares in the Vuelta Abajo for 2026-27
summary: Tabacuba hopes to plant 14,000 hectares in the Vuelta Abajo next season — the same target missed in 2025-26 — leaning on a rapid build-out of solar-powered irrigation in Pinar del Río.

title: Fifth Habanos Day Draws More Than 100 Guests to Costa Rica
summary: Costa Rica hosted the fifth Habanos Day on May 16, organised by distributor Cruz Canela, with tastings centred on three anniversary brands — Cohiba at 60 and Cuaba and Vegueros at 30.

title: The Near-Lost Cohiba Novedosos Finally Reaches Andorra
summary: Announced in 2019 and stalled by the pandemic, the LCDH-exclusive Novedosos (156 mm x 50) is on sale in Andorra at EUR 5,350 per box of 25, practically its first retail availability worldwide.

title: Santi Eiroa's 1916 Tabacalera Traces the Family Story in an All-Honduran Blend
summary: The fourth generation of the Eiroa family, Santi Eiroa, builds his first start-to-finish line around five-year-aged habano and the rare Pinareño leaf — five sizes at $16 to $19, sold through only about 100 U.S. retailers.

title: La Flor de Cano Mágicos Returns to Spain as Aged Stock Under 'Fuera de Serie'
summary: Distributor Tabacalera S.L.U. has re-released aged stock of Spain's 2018 Regional Edition La Flor de Cano Mágicos under its 'Fuera de Serie' aging program, at €20 a cigar against €8 at its 2020 debut.

title: Plasencia Triunfal Pairs Honduran and Nicaraguan Organic Leaf for the 2026 World Cup
summary: Plasencia's second straight World Cup cigar is a 6 1/4 x 54 gran toro limited to 5,000 numbered boxes at $59.99 — the company's first cigar to combine certified organic tobacco from both Honduras and Nicaragua.

title: La Casa del Habano Milano Celebrates 20 Years at the Portrait Milano
summary: Brothers Luca and Simone Borla marked two decades of La Casa del Habano Milano with an anniversary evening at the Portrait Milano, unveiling a DeArt commemorative humidor limited to 50 pieces.

title: Two New Habanos Specialist Stores Take Vietnam's Network to 14
summary: New Habanos Specialist stores in Ho Chi Minh City and Nha Trang have taken Vietnam's network to 14 stores, in an expansion led by Avanti Group with exclusive distributor Golden Phoenix Vietnam.

title: The Cigar Humidor Is Bogotá's Newest Habanos Specialist
summary: A 172 m² Habanos Specialist sharing its space with a specialty coffee shop has opened in Bogotá, as Colombia's once fake-ridden market shifts toward authorised specialist stores.

title: Juan López Bésame Mucho, a Regional Edition for Mexico, Debuts in April
summary: The Sublimes-format (164 mm x 54) Bésame Mucho launched at an April 24 event in Val'quirico with retail release the next day, priced at about MXN $1,066 (about $60).

title: La Casa del Habano Opens Pall Mall Flagship in London
summary: Dominique London opened its La Casa del Habano flagship at 26 Pall Mall on March 25, with two walk-in humidors, a basement lounge for rare and vintage cigars, and four opening parties.

title: Cohiba Wide Short Gets Its First Limited Edition: a 50-Cigar Humidor
summary: The Cohiba Wide Short 50 Limited Edition 2024 puts 50 cigarillos of 100% Cuban black tobacco in a limited humidor sold through Spanish specialist shops at EUR 225.

title: Montecristo L'Esprit 'Le Crépuscule' Humidor Presented in Portugal
summary: Empor S.A. presented the Montecristo L'Esprit 'Le Crépuscule' humidor — 50 Preciosos cigars, 200 numbered units — to the Portuguese market at the sixth Empor Habanos Moments on March 5, 2026.

title: Switzerland's Tenth La Casa del Habano Opens Inside a Five-Star Hotel in Montreux
summary: Intertabak and Habanos S.A. inaugurated Switzerland's tenth La Casa del Habano on March 19 — the country's first inside a five-star palace hotel, at the Fairmont Montreux Palace on the shores of Lake Geneva.

title: Cuba's 2025-26 Harvest: 11,426 Hectares in the Vuelta Abajo, Up on Last Year but Short of Target
summary: The 2025-26 season ended with 11,426 hectares planted in the Vuelta Abajo, up from about 10,500 the year before but well short of the 14,000-hectare target, as rain, drought and the energy crisis cut into the crop.

title: Habanos Declares 2026 the 'Cohiba Year' for the Brand's 60th Anniversary
summary: Cigar Journal reports that Habanos S.A. is building its 2026 around the 60th anniversary of Cohiba, the most prestigious brand in its portfolio, under the banner of a year-long 'Cohiba Year'.

title: Hoyo de Monterrey Marks 160 Years with a Spanish-Only Le Hoyo de Rio Seco Edition
summary: For the brand's 160th anniversary, Habanos released a limited edition of Le Hoyo de Rio Seco, factory name Aromosos (140 mm x 56), exclusively in the Spanish market.

title: 26th Festival del Habano Postponed, Organizers Announce
summary: Weeks before the Feb. 23-27 dates, the organizing committee postponed the festival to protect its standards of quality and experience; a new date was promised through official channels.

title: Punch Nectares No. 50, Ireland's First Regional Edition, Launches in London
summary: Ireland's first Edicion Regional revives the Nectares name discontinued in the 1980s, a Magnum 50 (160 mm x 50) in 1,400 cabinets of 50, wearing the 'Exclusivo Irlanda' band for the first time.

title: Trinidad Corcel, the Brand's First Chinese New Year Release, Debuts in Hong Kong
summary: The 55 x 135 mm Patricios, Trinidad's first special release honouring the Lunar New Year, made its world debut on January 29 in Hong Kong, in individually numbered cases of 18 with NFC authentication.

title: Cohiba Behike BHK 58 Reaches Switzerland in the 15th Anniversary Selection Box
summary: The largest Behike yet, 178 mm x 58, arrived at Swiss La Casa del Habano stores on Feb. 3 inside the four-cigar 15 Aniversario Selection box priced at CHF 1,696, with Habanos Specialists following on Feb. 10.

title: Punch Princesas Edición Limitada 2025 Reaches Switzerland at CHF 52
summary: Punch's 185th-anniversary Limited Edition (135 mm x 52) went on sale at Swiss La Casa del Habano stores on February 3 and at Habanos Specialists on February 10, priced at CHF 52 per cigar.

title: Fonseca Du Nord: Canada's First Regional Edition of the Plain-Packaging Era
summary: The Genios-format (52 x 140 mm) Fonseca Du Nord launched across Toronto, Montreal, Winnipeg and Vancouver in January 2026, the first Habanos Regional Edition for Canada since plain packaging took effect.

title: Spain's 2026 Cuban Cigar Prices Rise a Modest 3.83% on Average
summary: Halfwheel's comparison of Spain's roughly 350-SKU price list finds the premium lines and Trinidad held flat, a sharp slowdown from the increases of 2023 and 2025, with the Cohiba Ideales the dearest cigar at EUR 550.

title: 26th Festival del Habano Sells Out as Cohiba's 60th Anniversary Drives Demand
summary: All tickets for the Feb. 23-27 festival were sold through the Habanos distribution network, which told distributors that extraordinary demand tied to Cohiba's 60th anniversary left nothing for public sale.

title: Trinidad Villa: a New LCDH-Exclusive Vitola Named for a World Heritage City
summary: Unveiled in Mexico City on November 13, 2025, the Julieta No. 3 (47 x 170 mm) Villa is exclusive to La Casa del Habano and Habanos Specialists, in boxes of 12.

title: Twenty Years of 'Exclusivo Suiza': Switzerland's Regional Editions
summary: Switzerland has commissioned a Habanos Regional Edition almost every year since the program began in 2005 — from the 2005 Punch Robusto and Ramón Allones Eminencia to the delayed 2023 Por Larrañaga Intemporales.

title: A Quarter Century of the 'Books': Inside the Colección Habanos
summary: Launched in 2001 with a 300-box Cuaba, the book-shaped Colección Habanos has grown to volumes of up to 2,000 boxes of 20 — and remains among the most collectible modern Habanos series.

title: BVI Court Move Could Return Chen Zhi's Habanos Stake to His Companies
summary: Tobacco Reporter says a BVI High Court decision could restore control over entities tied to a 28.55% interest in Habanos — while Chen denies the allegations and separate U.S. and EU measures continue.

title: 5th Avenue's Insolvency Leaves Habanos Distribution in Three European Markets in Limbo
summary: The Habanos distributor for Germany, Austria and Poland entered formal insolvency on Nov. 1, weeks after EU sanctions left it unable to fulfil orders, Halfwheel reports.

title: Selected Tobacco's Petit Edition Packs Five Tubed Cigars and Two New Vitolas
summary: The $164 five-cigar set adds the Bandolero Premium Intrépidos and Nelson Nobles, with shipping to retailers scheduled to begin in mid-November.

title: Aladino's Elegante Brings a Pinareño Lancero to the 85 Aniversario Reserva
summary: The 7 x 38 third vitola is all Honduran pinareño, priced at $22, limited to qualifying retailers and scheduled to ship during the week of Nov. 9.

title: Drew Estate Puts Ten Blends in the Feral Flying Pig Shape
summary: A ten-cigar collection gathers eight first-time Feral Flying Pig releases at $170, while a separate box-pressed El Tigre Dominicano Flying Pig appears to be a retail first.

title: Drew Estate Plans to Move El Tigre Dominicano Production to a New Dominican Factory
summary: The line is currently made at La Gran Fábrica Drew Estate in Nicaragua; production is expected to shift when the company's upcoming Dominican factory opens next year.

title: Brick House Beginnings Returns for TAA 2026 in a Five-Year-Aged Version
summary: J.C. Newman's Ciento por Ciento is a 6 1/4 x 54 all-Nicaraguan cigar priced at $12 and limited to 8,000 cigars for TAA retailers; this version was aged for five years.

title: Perez-Carrillo Battleborn Returns for 2026 With a New Cameroon Blend
summary: The Heroes 6 x 52 is $21, packed in 21-count boxes with dog tags, and limited to 2,000 boxes — 42,000 cigars — with launch events held on Oct. 22–23.

title: The Fuente Story and the Legend of Opus X
summary: How a Tampa family firm came to grow wrapper in the Dominican Republic and create the cigar that changed an industry.

title: Padrón: Sixty Years of the King Who Never Advertises
summary: No advertising, no shortcuts: the Padrón family's six decades from Havana to Estelí.

title: Joya de Nicaragua: The Pride of Nicaragua's Oldest Brand
summary: Nicaragua's first premium cigar factory, and the brand that carried a country's name around the world.
